rules_applied.outcome: Embedded invoice copy in certificate file not used
Invoice file contains wholly different invoice number

goods_description.motivation: The certificate contains a general goods description with explicit invoice reference: invoice number 779910 dated 2025-11-06. The separate invoice file used for verification is invoice 780687 dated 2025-Nov-19. Because the referenced invoice number and date do not match the invoice file, the goods-description control point fails immediately.

quantity.invoice_value: Separate invoice 780687 lists only line-level Kg values such as 0.50, 0.60, 1.02, 0.64 and 0.40; no total net weight of 312.44 KG is stated.

rules_applied.outcome: Summation attempted; line weights do not support 312.44 KG NET

quantity.motivation: The certificate quantity is an explicit net weight: 312,44 KG NET. The separate invoice file does not state a matching total net weight, and the visible line-level Kg values are far below 312.44 KG even if summed. The certificate quantity therefore cannot be verified against the invoice.

origin.invoice_value: CoO values in the separate invoice file include CHN, MMR and SWE

rules_applied.outcome: Not every certificate origin can be explicitly identified in the invoice

origin.motivation: The certificate origin field lists CN, TR and IN. In the separate invoice file, the explicit CoO entries are CHN, MMR and SWE. CN can be normalized to CHN, but TR and IN are not present, so not every origin stated in the certificate is explicitly identifiable in the invoice.

critical_failures: The certificate explicitly refers to invoice 779910 dated 2025-11-06, but the separate invoice file is invoice 780687 dated 2025-11-19.
The consignee in the certificate is EURL Renault Trucks Algeria, while the invoice delivery address is Volvo Group Korea.
The certificate origins TR and IN cannot be identified in the invoice.
The certificate quantity 312,44 KG NET cannot be verified in the invoice.
overall_assessment.decision_summary: Document A is treated as the certificate file and Document B as the separate invoice file. Under the file-pairing rules, the embedded invoice copy inside the certificate file is not a valid verification basis. Since the certificate refers to invoice 779910 dated 2025-11-06 but the separate invoice file is invoice 780687 dated 2025-11-19, the pair is not identical; further control points also show mismatches for consignee, quantity and origin.
overall_assessment.human_explanation: Certifikatet hänvisar till faktura 779910 daterad 2025-11-06, men den separata bifogade fakturan är nummer 780687 daterad 2025-11-19. Mottagaren i certifikatet är EURL Renault Trucks Algeria medan fakturan avser Volvo Group Korea, och ursprungsländerna TR och IN återfinns inte i fakturan. Dokumentparet kan därför inte godkännas automatiskt.
